name: Poise Palm
description: Strike with a flat palm that lands with exactly the weight the opponent put into his last motion.

name: Plumb Guard
description: Hold the body upright on its true line with a level film of qi that spreads a blow evenly.

name: Poise Step
description: Move one level pace with the weight never leaving the center so the body is always ready.

name: Slowing Breath
description: Breathe a slow level breath with an ally to quiet a racing pulse and ease shallow pain.

name: Weighing Glance
description: Weigh the strength of nearby qi against the user's own to judge who stands higher.

name: Counterweight Turn
description: Turn with a push so that the force of the strike is cancelled by the force of the turn.

name: Equal Palm
description: Meet a push with a palm of equal strength so that both arms stop and the opponent staggers.

name: Tare Guard
description: Meet the weight of a blow with an equal weight of qi so that nothing passes through.

name: Counterpace
description: Step to match the opponent's pace and keep the same distance whichever way he moves.

name: Tally Flick
description: Flick a drop of qi at the opponent that carries exactly the weight of the last blow he landed.

name: Cadence Lift
description: Set a steady cadence of breath with an ally so that their strength comes level and even.

name: Opposing Sway
description: Sway against the lean of an attack so that the two motions cancel and the blow falls short.

name: Evening Touch
description: Rest a level hand on a hurt ally and draw the pain and the swelling toward ease.

name: Plumb Strike
description: Drop the fist straight down the hanging line of the body onto the target's guard.

name: Hanging Ward
description: Let a plumb line of qi hang before the body so that blows swing off it to either side.

name: Pivot Slide
description: Pivot on the line of the spine and slide a pace aside without any lean.

name: Level Reading
description: Feel how level the ground and the people on it are and where a stance is tilted.

name: Settle Touch
description: Rest on an ally's shoulder and let the line of his body settle so that strain eases.

name: Hush Cuff
description: Cuff the shoulder with a level palm that stops a swing in its middle and leaves the arm dull.

name: Scale Palm
description: Press a palm onto the opponent's chest and add exactly the weight that tips his stance.

name: Balanced Ward
description: Set a beam of qi across the front with equal force on both ends so the whole holds still.

name: Beam Step
description: Walk a narrow line with arms held out like a beam and never lose the center.

name: Counterpoise Jab
description: Jab with the free hand at the instant the other arm is struck so that both forces cancel.

name: Weight Cast
description: Cast a bead of qi that weighs the same as the one thrown at the user.

name: Scale Reading
description: Set the user's qi against another's on an inner scale to learn which side sinks.

name: Settling Lift
description: Lift an ally's tired side until both his arms and both his legs feel the same strength.

name: Even Grip
description: Take the opponent's wrist and hold it with equal strength so every pull he makes fails.
